001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModelDefinition;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
007
008import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
009
010public abstract class AbstractInstanceNodeItem<
011    D extends IDefinition,
012    I extends INamedInstance,
013    P extends IModelNodeItem<? extends IModelDefinition, ? extends INamedInstance>>
014    extends AbstractNodeItem
015    implements IDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
016
017  @NonNull
018  private final I instance;
019  @NonNull
020  private final P parent;
021
022  public AbstractInstanceNodeItem(
023      @NonNull I instance,
024      @NonNull P parent) {
025    this.instance = instance;
026    this.parent = parent;
027  }
028
029  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
030  @Override
031  public D getDefinition() {
032    return (D) getInstance().getDefinition();
033  }
034
035  @Override
036  public I getInstance() {
037    return instance;
038  }
039
040  @Override
041  public P getParentNodeItem() {
042    return parent;
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  public P getParentContentNodeItem() {
047    return getParentNodeItem();
048  }
049}
